description: This PHP class 'DataType' defines constants for different cell data types used in PhpSpreadsheet, manages error codes, and provides utility functions for string validation and error code checking within spreadsheet cell data handling.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: Defines cell data types, manages error codes, and provides utility functions for data validation in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: getErrorCodes
methods.description: Returns the array mapping error strings to their corresponding error codes.

methods.name: checkString
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a string to satisfy Excel requirements, supporting RichText objects and truncating long strings.

methods.name: checkErrorCode
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a value to ensure it is a recognized Excel error code, defaulting to '#NULL!' if invalid.
